answer: Picture a meadow where every newcomer must cross a toll bridge. Before an agent can earn rewards, an established peer has to vouch for it by locking a bond, which is slashed if the newcomer is caught colluding or spamming. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand identities now needs a thousand bonds or a thousand gullible sponsors, and loses collateral the moment one clone is exposed. Generating a sonnet is cheap, but risking real money behind each fake voice is not, so mass impersonation stops paying.
